name: Virtual Try-On Bot
tagline: See yourself in saved outfits as a short AI video before you buy
description: Save the clothes you are eyeing and it renders a short Grok Imagine clip that shows you in the outfit, working from a personal character reference so it looks like you. When a look works, links to the items follow. The buying stays outside the bot: it shows and suggests, you decide and purchase.
author: paranoidream
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
